title: Turbocharge special needs internships to help tackle UK youth jobs crisis, says Milburn

paragraphs.en: Specialist internships designed to secure work for young people with special educational needs should be put on “turbocharge” to help tackle the growing youth jobs crisis, a government review is to propose.
paragraphs.zh: 一项政府审查将提议，为有特殊教育需求的年轻人提供工作而设计的专业实习应“全速推进”，以帮助应对日益严重的青年就业危机。

paragraphs.en: Alan Milburn who is leading a review of young people and work, said supported internships should be scaled up to combat “devastating” joblessness rates for young people with a learning disability, autism or mental illness.
paragraphs.zh: 正在主导一项关于青年与就业审查的艾伦·米尔本（Alan Milburn）表示，应扩大有支持的实习计划，以应对有学习障碍、自闭症或精神疾病的年轻人“毁灭性”的失业率。

paragraphs.en: Nationally, as few as 5% of some groups of young people with special educational needs and disabilities (Send) move into permanent jobs. However, employment rates among those who complete supported internship schemes can be as high as 70%.
paragraphs.zh: 在全国范围内，某些有特殊教育需求和残疾（Send）的年轻人群体中，只有少至5%的人能找到长期工作。然而，完成有支持的实习计划的人就业率可高达70%。

paragraphs.en: Nearly 1 million 16- to 24-year-olds in the UK are classified as Neet (not in employment, education or training), a 10-year high that Milburn – a former minister in the Tony Blair government – has said represents a moral crisis and is economically unsustainable.
paragraphs.zh: 英国约有近100万16至24岁的年轻人被归类为“尼特族”（Neet，即不在就业、教育或培训中），这是十年来的最高水平。曾任托尼·布莱尔政府部长的米尔本表示，这代表着一场道德危机，在经济上也是不可持续的。

paragraphs.en: Related: Number of young people out of work or training in UK could hit 1.25m by early 2030s
paragraphs.zh: 相关报道：到2030年代初，英国失业或未接受培训的年轻人数量可能达到125万

paragraphs.en: In May, his first report warned that Britain risked a 25% rise in the number of Neets to 1.25 million by the early 2030s without urgent government action. Central to the recent growth of Neets is an increase in young people diagnosed at school with neurodevelopmental conditions or mental illness who do not make the transition into work, leaving them at high risk of becoming economically inactive.
paragraphs.zh: 今年5月，他的首份报告警告称，若不采取紧急政府行动，到2030年代初，英国“尼特族”人数可能增加25%，达到125万。近期尼特族增长的核心，是在校期间被诊断患有神经发育障碍或精神疾病、却未能顺利过渡到工作的年轻人增多，使他们面临高度沦为经济活动不活跃人群的风险。

paragraphs.en: Milburn said the UK had to move away from the idea that people with a diagnosis were unable to work. They can work, he said. “The question is: are the opportunities there and is the support there?
paragraphs.zh: 米尔本说，英国必须摆脱“确诊者无法工作”的观念。他说，他们是可以工作的。“问题在于：机会是否在那里，支持是否到位？”

paragraphs.en: “Supported internships have got such an effective track record. With the best ones around 70% of the people on them end up in paid employment. In my view we have to turbocharge support – and at the moment the system is not set up to do that.”
paragraphs.zh: “有支持的实习有非常出色的成功记录。在最好的项目中，约70%的参与者最终获得了带薪工作。在我看来，我们必须全速推进这种支持——而目前这个体系的设置还无法做到这一点。”
